services.value: Pace provides analytical and environmental testing services and a range of professional services for laboratories and regulated operations, including cleanroom testing & certification, facility qualification/validation, and environmental monitoring. Services include items such as cleanroom qualification (e.g., particle counts, HEPA filter integrity/velocity, viable air/surface sampling) and environmental monitoring (e.g., air/surface/personnel/water/compressed gas monitoring and water testing).
